text: Could you add a tense instrumental bed to this cockpit clip, with no singing? I’m a little worried the music could overwhelm the radio chatter instead of supporting the tension. What I mean is, keep the entire attached 7-second clip exactly as it is visually, without changing the footage, timing, or framing. Keep the music clearly quieter than the radio calls whenever someone speaks so every original word is easy to hear, especially 'Rook, you with me?' Please keep the original radio-call recording in sync, without replacing it or adding any text. The instruments and musical style are your call.
